Barcode scan karein ya naam likh kar Ent: Scan a barcode or type a name and press Enter.

Bill aur udhaar ki yaad-dehani WhatsApp: Bill and credit reminders on WhatsApp

Combos setup page se banayein: Create combos from the setup page
Counter par aise dikhegi: How it will look at the counter

Counter par ek tap me bikne wali cheezei: Items sold with one tap at the counter — order, colour and group

Customer chunein, phir Udhaar. Kuch pais: Select the customer, then Credit. If some money was paid, the rest goes on credit by itself.

Ek type chunein to seedha wahi bikegi. W: Pick a type to sell that one directly. Otherwise the type is asked at the counter.

Is dukaan me haath se Discount band hai: Manual discount is turned off in this shop
Is dukaan me haath se discount band hai: Manual discount is turned off in this shop (Settings)

Naam, SKU, barcode ya Urdu naam: Name, SKU, barcode or Urdu name
Naam, SKU, rang ya size se Variant dhoon: Find a variant by name, SKU, colour or size
Nafaa AI ka bill POS me khul gaya: Nafaa AI bill opened in POS
Offline — sale save ho gayi, net aate hi: Offline — sale saved, it will upload when internet is back
Offline — sales is computer par save hon: Offline — sales will be saved on this computer
On karein to sirf aap ko dikhegi. Band h: When on, only you see it. When off, all cashiers see it.
Optional — khali bhi chhor sakte hain: Optional — you can leave it empty
Pehle upar se shop chunein: Choose a shop at the top first
Pehle wohi Batch bikta hai jis ki Expiry: The batch with the nearest expiry sells first. To sell another batch, choose it here.
Percent, rupay, ya bill gol karein: Percent, rupees, or round off the bill
Percent, rupay, ya bill ko 10/50/100 par: Percent, rupees, or round the bill to 10/50/100.

Poori dukaan ke liye layout aur counter: Layout and counter parts for the whole shop
Popup band hai — browser mein popups all: Popup is blocked — allow popups in the browser

Price tier badalne ki permission nahi: No permission to change price tier
Products baayen, bill daayen: Products on the left, bill on the right
Quick key ban gayi — POS par dikh rahi h: Quick key created — it is showing on POS
Quick keys setup page se banayein: Create quick keys from the setup page
Rate badlein (Enter phir Tab, ya R): Change rate (Enter then Tab, or R)
Reports ka print, PDF, header aur footer: Report printing, PDF, header and footer

Sale hote hi bill printer par chala jaye: Print the bill as soon as the sale is done
Search mein naam likhein, Enter se pehla: Type the name in search, Enter adds the first result to the bill. Use − + on the card for quantity.

Sirf aap ke liye, is computer par: Only for you, on this computer
A picture helps the cashier find it fast. If none is picked, ⚡ shows.
